message:
Running Python code interactively: data = open('/tmp/testcase.exr','rb').read()
print(len(data))
# EXR header
import struct
magic = data[0:4]
version = struct.unpack('<I', data[4:8])[0]
print("magic:", magic.hex(), "version:", hex(version))
# attributes start at offset 8
off = 8
attrs = {}
while True:
    # read attribute name (null-terminated string)
    end = data.index(b'\x00', off)
    name = data[off:end].decode()
    off = end + 1
    # type
    end = data.index(b'\x00', off)
    typ = data[off:end].decode()
    off = end + 1
    # size (4 bytes)
    size = struct.unpack('<I', data[off:off+4])[0]
    off += 4
    val = data[off:off+size]
    off += size
    attrs[name] = (typ, val)
    print(f"attr {name!r} type={typ!r} size={size}")
    if name == 'channels':
        break
print("offset after channels:", off)
print("attrs keys:", list(attrs.keys()))
